Left unset, as every POSTTRAN execution leaves run-time parameters the adapter does not carry (pure renaming, notebook §41): every row that passes the checks becomes a record error
- END: Post daily transactions (line 107) writes posttran_transact/_dalyrejs/_acctdata/_tcatbal at the root; the last node 'Escape text' outputs only endText, so the END output is decoded as delivered (contract names; _root result merged when present)
